recentItems.title: Mutton Ghee Roast with Suhana Masala | Eid Special
recentItems.description:
Mutton Ghee Roast Recipe a masaledar preparation of mutton tossed in a fiery blend of spices with the added goodness of jaggery and tangy tamarind that balance out the flavours. 
Now you don't need to worry about masalas separately. Just get a pack of Suhana Mutton Masala.

SUBSCRIBE to Awesome Sauce for more such recipes ► https://goo.gl/YEdp6J

Ingredients:
Mutton- 1kg 
Ghee- 5 tbsp
Dried Kashmiri red chilli- 6-8 
Ginger-garlic paste- 1 tbsp
Turmeric powder- ½ tsp
Salt to Taste
Water- 5 cups
Curd- 3 tbsp
Tamarind pulp- 1 tsp
Yogurt- 3 tbsp
Salt to taste
Suhana Mutton Masala
Curry leaves- 1 twig
Jaggery- 1 Tbsp

Method:
For Mutton:
Take a pressure cooker.
Add 3tbsp ghee
Add ginger-garlic paste
Add turmeric
Add mutton and salt to taste.
Add water
Cook for 5-6 whistle
Separate the broth
For masala:
Dry fry the Dried Kashmiri red chilli
Grind it with ginger and garlic
Add tamarind pulp
Add water
Make a fine paste

For the main preparation:
Take a pan.
Add the remaining ghee.
Mix Suhana Mutton masala and the dried Kashmiri masala in the yogurt
Now add it in the ghee.
Cook till the oil separates.
Now add the broth.
Add salt to taste.
Add jaggery
Cook till the oil separates and the color changes.
Add the cooked mutton
Mix it well and roast it for 10 minutes.
Add curry leaves.
Cook it for another 15 minutes till the color changes to brown.

recentItems.title: Palak Paneer Pizza with Suhana Palak Paneer Masala | Awesome Sauce India
recentItems.description:
Happiness is in having pizza and Sukoon is only in having 'Fusion Pizza'.
Indian Bhi, Italian Bhi.
Try this recipe with Suhana Palak Paneer Masala.

Buy Suhana Palak Paneer Masala Here - https://bit.ly/3aNOJMp
.
.
Palak Paneer Chapati Pizza

Ingredients –

Palak Puree – 400 gms
Paneer – 200 gms
Tomato Puree – 100 gms
Onion – 1
Suhana Palak Paneer Mix 
Oil – 4 Tbsp
Water – 200 ml

For Pizza
Chapati Dough 
Oil – 2 Tbsp 
Sweet Corn – 20 gms
Onion Rings 
½ Cup Mozzarella Cheese
¼ Cup Processed Cheese 
Chilli Flakes – To Sprinkle

Method-
To Make Palak Paneer - Follow the instructions mentioned on the pack.
To Make Pizza –
Roll out the chapati dough into a thick chapati.
Now take a pan, add oil and place the roti on it.
Cook on both sides.
When it is almost done add prepared Palak Paneer on it. Spread it throughout.
Place onion rings, then grate cheese over it and few more onion rings and red chilli
flakes.
Cover the pan with a lid and let the chapatti cook till cheese melts.
Serve hot with ketchup.

recentItems.title: Mutter Paneer Patti Samosa with Suhana Mutter Paneer Masala | Awesome Sauce India
recentItems.description:
The samosa always manages to get us wanting more! This snack obliges to be one of the most delectable street foods and one of the most luscious appetizers in posh eateries all over India.
So why not make this favorite snack more interesting and unique.
Try out the new way of making samosa only with @Suhana Mutter Paneer Masala.


Buy @Suhana Mutter Paneer Masala Here - https://amzn.to/2vLYfAz
.
Mutter Paneer Patti Samosas
Ingredients:
Paneer cubes: ½ cup
Blanched peas: ½ cup
Samosa patties: 6
Tomato puree: 2 medium
Suhana Mutter Paneer Mix
Oil: 2 tbsp
Water: 1 cup
Fresh coriander: for garnish

For the filling: 
Make a paste of Suhana Mutter Paneer Mix with ½ water
Heat oil in a pan, add tomato puree and cook for 4- 5 minutes or until the oil separates. 
Add green peas and saute for 1-2 minutes.
Add the paste and saute for 2-3 minutes.
Add paneer, and the remaining water and simmer for 8-10 minutes or till the water evaporates.
Garnish it with chopped coriander leaves. 

For the samosa: 
Now take a samosa Patti and put a spoonful of filling on it and wrap the samosa.
Take a pan and pour oil for fry.
Heat the oil.
Now deep fry the samosas.
Serve it hot.

recentItems.title: Pav Bhaji Fondue with Suhana Masala | Awesome Sauce India
recentItems.description:
Love Pav Bhaji and can't get over it?
Try out this twist in your regular Pav Bhaji and make it even more interesting.
Also, use Suhana Pav Bhaji masala as it's addictive.


Get the Suhana Pav Bhaji masala: https://www.amazon.in/stores/page/70AB235B-0119-4F17-A7EB-9D0B0DCD643D?channel=ASI%20Pavbhaji


Ingredients:-
Boiled Potatoes – 5

Green Peas – 150 gms

Carrots – 150 gms

Onion – 3

Tomatoes – 4-5

Capsicum – 2

Green Chillies – 3

Garlic – 2-3 Tbsp

Ginger – 2 Tbsp

Salt to taste

Red Chilli Powder – 1 Tbsp

Suhana’s Pav Bhaji Masala – 3 Tbsp

Butter – 3 Tbsp

Coriander – For Garnish

Oil – 4-5 Tbsp


Method –

Take a pressure cooker, add oil and let it heat.

Then chopped ginger & garlic. Sauté it for a moment.

Now add green chillies.

Add onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes till it turns golden brown.

Then add Tomato, sauté well. Add salt, red chilli powder.

Then add potato, peas, carrots & capsicum. Mix all the veggies well and then add

¼ cup of water.

Cover the lid. Let it cook.

After 6-8 whistles, turn off the induction/gas.

Let it cool and then open the cooker.

Now take a blender and put all the veggies and blend it well to make a smooth

paste.

Take a deep pan, add butter and then Suhana Pav Bhaji Masala, stir once and add

in the blended veggies.

To toast pav

Take a pan, add butter and pav cubes. Top it with some red chilli powder and

chopped coriander.

Toast the cubes till they are crisp.

Serve Bhaji in the fondue pot along with pav cubes.
.
.
